title: Navy Blue Account: Wire Transfer Pricing
summary: This document covers Navy Blue Account wire transfer pricing: $15.00 per outgoing domestic wire, and free incoming domestic wires up to 5 per month (additional incoming wires may be fee-charged). Outgoing fees apply at submission; incoming credits post, with any post-allotment incoming fee assessed separately.
